DescText: ● Protocol 1: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, and SPD increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. The **quantity of Domains increases, and "Conversion" Domains will appear in the Second Plane. Equations received are more random.**

● Protocol 2: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, and SPD increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. **The Wishpower required to increase Mask Level increases. Expanding Equations requires more Blessings.**

● Protocol 3: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, and SPD increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. **Boss enemies in the First and Second Planes change, will enter Berserk sooner, and will stack Berserk faster.**

● Protocol 4: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, and SPD increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. The **Domain quantity further increases.**

● Protocol 5: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, and SPD increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak> respectively. **Upon entering the First Plane, gain 1 Grand Miracle. The Wishpower required to increase Mask Level increases. Expanding Equations requires more Blessings.**

● Protocol 6: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, SPD, and Max Toughness increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. **Enemies in the Berserk state advance their action after being attacked. After the emergence of Berserk, ally target's DMG dealt also increases, but the HP restored and Shield Effect gained decrease.**

● Protocol 7: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, SPD, and Max Toughness increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. **Prices of the items in the Store increase by <unbreak>5[i]%</unbreak>. Upon entering the First Plane, gains <unbreak>6[i]</unbreak> random Lv. 1 Domain(s).**

● Protocol 8: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, SPD, and Max Toughness increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak>, respectively. **Upon entering the First Plane, gains a special and random Absolute Failure Prescription.**

● Protocol 9: Enemy stats increase along with the planes, with their ATK, Max HP, SPD, and Max Toughness increasing by a max of <unbreak>1[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>2[i]%</unbreak>, <unbreak>3[i]%</unbreak>, and <unbreak>4[i]%</unbreak>, respectively.
